exposure: Obstetricians who had been sued or knew a colleague who had been sued vs. those who had not
cohort: 403 Brazilian gynecologists and obstetricians (GOs) who were members of premier Brazilian professional associations of gynecology and obstetrics.
finding: The study found that the majority of Brazilian GOs perform defensive Cesarean sections due to fear of litigation.
mod_finding: Defensive Cesarean sections are performed by Brazilian GOs due to fear of litigation.
